label: Local checks lift joint support at most to shared risk; ERROR_DEPENDENCE_3 adds nothing
paraphrase: In every shared-plus-local profile with n≥1 and ν(Fᶜ)≠0, conditioning on no local flag gives all-true probability κ(G)·(ν(C∩Fᶜ)/ν(Fᶜ))^n, which is at most κ(G); the conditioned probability of the shared condition itself is exactly κ(G); and each conditioned assertion has probability κ(G)·ν(C∩Fᶜ)/ν(Fᶜ). If the flag fires exactly on local error (F=Cᶜ), the conditioned all-true probability and each conditioned assertion are κ(G) and at-least-one-false is 1−κ(G) for every n, so only the shared risk remains, and no threshold t>1/2 of the policy (PRO_TANTO_SUPPORT_THRESHOLD_FULL_BELIEF_1) accepts both a conditioned assertion and the conditioned at-least-one-false event. If absence of a flag is independent of local correctness (ERROR_DEPENDENCE_3), conditioning on no flag leaves the all-true probability unchanged. Local checks whose no-flag event favors local correctness (ν(C∩Fᶜ)/ν(Fᶜ)>ν(C), an unregistered algebraic reading of the formula) reduce the count-driven local risk; checks that are blind to the shared condition by the construction of this model leave its probability unchanged; truth-independent checks change nothing. Checks sensitive to the shared condition are outside the model. Stipulated model only; whether actual checks are discriminating is open.
